steps.script: if (!window.__anybodyReady) return "saving a team really saves it"; document.getElementById('teamName').value = 'A team a check made'; document.getElementById('teamSave').click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if ((teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made'))     return 'saving a team really saves it';   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'nothing was saved: ' + document.getElementById('teamSaid').textContent

'a box can be opened to change who does it'   : 'the window did not open with anybody to choose'

Choose what this one does

steps.note: Save what was chosen

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (!document.getElementById('teamNodeDialog').open) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return teamGraph.nodes.filter(one => one.type === 'evaluator').length >= 1   ? 'saving that window really changes the box'   : 'nothing changed'

steps.text: the window is open with a change in it
steps.note: Open a box and change something without saving

steps.script: if (!window.__anybodyReady) return 'pressed or not needed'; document.getElementById('teamNodeCancel').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return 'pressed or not needed'

'checking it says what it found' : 'checking it said nothing'
steps.text: checking it says what it found
steps.note: And says what it found, whether that is a problem or nothing at all

steps.script: window.confirm = () => true; if ((teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made')) {   teamOpen = 'A team a check made';   document.getElementById('teamRemove').click();   for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {     if (!(teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made')) break;     await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));   } } if ((teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made')) {   await request('/api/who-is-on-it/remove',     {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({name: 'A team a check made'})}); } await refreshTeam(); return (teamSavedNames || []).some(one => one.name === 'A team a check made')   ? 'it is still there' : 'removing a team really removes it'

cases.title: Every way of looking at one automation has a panel behind it

steps.note: Open the pipelines view

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pipeline-tab]')]; const panes = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pipeline-pane]')]; if (tabs.length < 4) return 'it offers only ' + tabs.length + ' ways to look at it'; const named = tabs.map(one => one.dataset.pipelineTab).sort(); const behind = panes.map(one => one.dataset.pipelinePane).sort(); const missing = named.filter(one => !behind.includes(one)); const orphaned = behind.filter(one => !named.includes(one)); if (missing.length) return 'these have nothing behind them: ' + missing.join(', '); if (orphaned.length) return 'these are behind no tab: ' + orphaned.join(', '); const silent = tabs.filter(one => !one.textContent.trim()); if (silent.length) return 'a tab has no words on it'; return 'every way of looking at it has something behind it'
steps.text: every way of looking at it has something behind it
steps.note: Every tab over the board has a panel, and every panel has a tab
The same thing as text

steps.script: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const text = document.getElementById('pipelineCode').value; if (!text.includes('nodes')) return 'the text panel was empty'; const read = JSON.parse(text); read.name = 'Renamed in the text panel'; document.getElementById('pipelineCode').value = JSON.stringify(read, null, 2); return 'the picture is written out as text you can change'
steps.text: the picture is written out as text you can change
steps.note: It writes the pipeline out, and you can change it there

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 100; tries += 1) {   if (document.getElementById('pipelineName').value === 'Renamed in the text panel') break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } return document.getElementById('pipelineName').value === 'Renamed in the text panel'   ? 'changing the text changes the picture'   : 'the picture did not follow the text'

steps.note: Changing the text really changes the picture

steps.script: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return document.getElementById('pipelineCodeSaid').textContent.length > 3   ? 'copying says what happened' : 'copying said nothing'

steps.script: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const kinds = document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-help-one').length; return kinds >= 10 ? 'every kind of step says what it is for'   : 'only ' + kinds + ' kinds were explained'

cases.title: The ready-made pipelines are grouped, searchable, and every one really loads

steps.note: Open the pipelines view

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter').length) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const many = document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter').length; const groups = document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter-group').length; return many >= 10 && groups >= 2   ? 'there are enough of them, in groups'   : 'it showed ' + many + ' in ' + groups + ' groups'
steps.text: there are enough of them, in groups
steps.note: Nobody starts from an empty board: there are ten, in groups

steps.text: release
steps.note: Search for one about releasing

steps.script: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const shown = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter')]   .map(one => one.textContent); if (!shown.length) return 'searching found nothing at all'; return shown.every(one => one.toLowerCase().includes('release')     || one.toLowerCase().includes('goes out'))   ? 'searching really narrows it down'   : 'it showed: ' + shown.join(' | ').slice(0, 80)
steps.text: searching really narrows it down
steps.note: Searching narrows it to the ones worth looking at

steps.script: document.getElementById('pipelineStarterSearch').value = 'zzzz-nothing'; document.getElementById('pipelineStarterSearch')   .dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const said = document.getElementById('pipelineStarters').textContent; document.getElementById('pipelineStarterSearch').value = ''; document.getElementById('pipelineStarterSearch')   .dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return said.includes('Nothing matches')   ? 'a search that finds nothing says so'   : 'it said: ' + said.slice(0, 60)
steps.text: a search that finds nothing says so
steps.note: And a search that finds nothing says so, rather than showing an empty list

steps.script: window.confirm = () => true; const one = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter')]   .find(item => item.textContent.includes('Ask me before it goes out')); if (!one) return 'the one that waits for a person is not there'; one.click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries += 1) {   if (document.getElementById('pipelineName').value === 'Ask me before it goes out') break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } const waits = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-node')]   .some(node => node.textContent.includes('Wait for a person')); return waits ? 'a ready-made one really loads onto the board'   : 'it loaded without the step it is named for: '     + document.getElementById('pipelineName').value

cases.title: One step on its own, carrying on from a step, and a step that waits for a person

steps.note: Open the pipelines view

steps.script: refreshPipelines = async () => {}; for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) { if (document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter').length) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } pipeline = {name: 'A check drew this', nodes: [{id: 'start', kind: 'start', label: 'Start', settings: {}, at: {x: 40, y: 120}}, {id: 'ask', kind: 'wait_for_a_person', label: 'Say yes', settings: {question: 'Shall this go on?'}, at: {x: 320, y: 120}}, {id: 'repo', kind: 'git_repo', label: 'Read the repo', settings: {}, at: {x: 600, y: 120}}], edges: [{from: 'start', to: 'ask'}, {from: 'ask', to: 'repo'}]}; document.getElementById('pipelineName').value = 'A check drew this'; renderPipeline(); window.__pipelineRequestWas = request; window.__pipelineRunBodies = []; window.__pipelineFakeRun = 0; request = async (path, options = {}) => { if (path === '/api/pipelines/run') { const body = JSON.parse(options.body || '{}'); const runId = 'qa-pipeline-' + (++window.__pipelineFakeRun); window.__pipelineRunBodies.push(body); setTimeout(() => { applyPipelineEvent({kind: 'pipeline_started', run_id: runId, payload: {run_id: runId, request_id: body.request_id, name: pipeline.name}}); const selected = body.only ? new Set([body.only]) : body.from_here ? new Set([body.from_here]) : new Set(pipeline.nodes.map(one => one.id)); let waiting = false; for (const node of pipeline.nodes) { let result; if (!selected.has(node.id) && (body.only || body.from_here)) result = {id: node.id, label: node.label, kind: node.kind, state: 'skipped', skipped_this_time: true}; else if (node.kind === 'wait_for_a_person' && !body.only && !body.from_here) { result = {id: node.id, label: node.label, kind: node.kind, state: 'running', said: node.settings.question}; waiting = true; } else if (!waiting) result = {id: node.id, label: node.label, kind: node.kind, state: 'passed', milliseconds: 5}; else continue; applyPipelineEvent({kind: 'pipeline_node', run_id: runId, payload: {...result, run_id: runId}}); } if (!waiting) applyPipelineEvent({kind: 'pipeline_finished', run_id: runId, payload: {run_id: runId, nodes: [...pipelineStates.values()], said: 'Finished'}}); }, 0); return {started: true, run_id: runId}; } if (path === '/api/pipelines/answer') { const body = JSON.parse(options.body || '{}'); const runId = body.run_id; window.__pipelineRunBodies.push(body); setTimeout(() => { applyPipelineEvent({kind: 'pipeline_node', run_id: runId, payload: {run_id: runId, id: 'ask', label: 'Say yes', kind: 'wait_for_a_person', state: body.carry_on ? 'passed' : 'failed'}}); if (body.carry_on) applyPipelineEvent({kind: 'pipeline_node', run_id: runId, payload: {run_id: runId, id: 'repo', label: 'Read the repo', kind: 'git_repo', state: 'passed', milliseconds: 5}}); applyPipelineEvent({kind: 'pipeline_finished', run_id: runId, payload: {run_id: runId, nodes: [...pipelineStates.values()], said: 'Finished'}}); }, 0); return {note: 'Answer recorded'}; } return window.__pipelineRequestWas(path, options); }; return 'a pipeline with a step that waits'
steps.text: a pipeline with a step that waits
steps.note: Draw one with a step that stops and asks

steps.script: const card = document.querySelector('[data-node="repo"]'); const alone = [...card.querySelectorAll('button')]   .find(one => one.textContent.trim() === 'Run only this'); if (!alone) return 'there is no way to run one step on its own'; alone.click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.getElementById('pipelineStop').disabled       && pipelineStates.size) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); } const left = [...pipelineStates.values()].filter(one => one.skipped_this_time).length; return left === 2 ? 'running only one step leaves the others alone'   : 'it left ' + left + ' alone'
steps.text: running only one step leaves the others alone
steps.note: Run only this: one step runs, the rest are left exactly as they were

steps.script: const card = document.querySelector('[data-node="repo"]'); const onward = [...card.querySelectorAll('button')]   .find(one => one.textContent.trim() === 'Carry on from here'); if (!onward) return 'there is no way to carry on from a step'; onward.click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.getElementById('pipelineStop').disabled       && pipelineStates.size) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); } const left = [...pipelineStates.values()].filter(one => one.skipped_this_time); return left.length === 2   ? 'carrying on from a step leaves the earlier ones alone'   : 'it left ' + left.length + ' alone'
steps.text: carrying on from a step leaves the earlier ones alone
steps.note: Carry on from here: this step and what waits on it, and nothing before

steps.script: await runPipeline(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (!document.getElementById('pipelineAsk').hidden) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); } const asks = document.getElementById('pipelineAsk').textContent; return asks.includes('Shall this go on?')   ? 'it stops and asks, in the words the step was given'   : 'it asked: ' + asks.slice(0, 60)
steps.text: it stops and asks, in the words the step was given
steps.note: A whole run stops at that step and asks the question written on it

steps.script: const yes = [...document.querySelectorAll('#pipelineAsk button')]   .find(one => one.textContent.includes('Carry on')); if (!yes) return 'there was no way to say carry on'; yes.click(); for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) {   if (document.getElementById('pipelineStop').disabled) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); } const after = pipelineStates.get('repo'); return after && after.state !== 'waiting'   ? 'saying carry on lets the rest run'   : 'the rest never ran'
steps.text: saying carry on lets the rest run
steps.note: Saying carry on lets the rest of the run go ahead
Look at the timeline

steps.script: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-timeline-row').length; const note = document.querySelector('.pipeline-timeline-note'); return rows >= 2 && note && note.textContent.includes('slowest')   ? 'the timeline shows a bar per step and names the slow one'   : 'it drew ' + rows + ' bars'
steps.text: the timeline shows a bar per step and names the slow one
steps.note: The timeline draws one bar per step and says which was slowest

steps.script: const stopHere = [...document.querySelectorAll('#pipelineAsk button')].find(one => one.textContent.includes('Stop here')); if (stopHere) stopHere.click(); if (window.__pipelineRequestWas) request = window.__pipelineRequestWas; delete window.__pipelineRequestWas; delete window.__pipelineRunBodies; delete window.__pipelineFakeRun; showPipelinePane('board'); pipeline = {name: 'New automation', nodes: [], edges: []}; pipelineSavedName = ''; renderPipeline(); return 'the board is back as it was'
steps.text: the board is back as it was
steps.note: And the board is left empty again, whatever happened above

cases.title: A step can be told to ask when the run starts, so one pipeline serves two jobs

steps.note: Open the pipelines view

steps.script: refreshPipelines = async () => {}; for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries += 1) { if (document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-starter').length) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } pipeline = {name: 'Asks first', nodes: [{id: 'start', kind: 'start', label: 'Start', settings: {}, at: {x: 40, y: 120}}, {id: 'checks', kind: 'suite', label: 'The checks', settings: {tag: 'fast'}, at: {x: 320, y: 120}}], edges: [{from: 'start', to: 'checks'}]}; window.__askPipelineRequestWas = request; window.__askPipelineRunBodies = []; request = async (path, options = {}) => { if (path === '/api/pipelines/run') { const body = JSON.parse(options.body || '{}'); const runId = 'qa-asked-pipeline'; window.__askPipelineRunBodies.push(body); setTimeout(() => { applyPipelineEvent({kind: 'pipeline_started', run_id: runId, payload: {run_id: runId, request_id: body.request_id, name: pipeline.name}}); const results = pipeline.nodes.map(node => ({run_id: runId, id: node.id, label: node.label, kind: node.kind, state: 'passed', milliseconds: 5})); for (const result of results) applyPipelineEvent({kind: 'pipeline_node', run_id: runId, payload: result}); applyPipelineEvent({kind: 'pipeline_finished', run_id: runId, payload: {run_id: runId, nodes: results, said: 'Finished'}}); }, 0); return {started: true, run_id: runId}; } return window.__askPipelineRequestWas(path, options); }; renderPipeline(); openPipelineNode('checks'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return document.getElementById('pipelineNodeDialog').open ? 'the settings window is open' : 'it did not open'

steps.script: const tick = document.querySelector('#pipelineNodeAskList [data-asks="tag"]'); if (!tick) return 'there is no way to say ask me for this'; tick.checked = true; document.getElementById('pipelineNodeSave').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const node = pipeline.nodes.find(one => one.id === 'checks'); return (node.settings.asks || []).includes('tag')   ? 'a step can be told to ask about one of its settings'   : 'nothing was remembered'

steps.script: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const card = document.querySelector('[data-node="checks"]'); return card && card.textContent.includes('Asks first')   ? 'the board says it will ask'   : 'the board said nothing about it'

steps.script: for (let tries = 0; tries < 100; tries += 1) {   if (document.getElementById('pipelineAskDialog').open) break;   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } const fields = document.querySelectorAll('#pipelineAskFields [data-ask-key]').length; return document.getElementById('pipelineAskDialog').open && fields === 1   ? 'pressing Run asks first'   : 'it asked about ' + fields + ' things'

steps.script: window.__sweep = {errors: [], results: []}; window.addEventListener('error', (e) => window.__sweep.errors.push(String(e.message))); window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (e) => window.__sweep.errors.push(String((e.reason && e.reason.message) || e.reason))); window.prompt = () => { throw new Error('prompt() is and will not be supported.'); }; window.confirm = () => true; window.alert = () => {}; const anything = new Proxy(function () {}, {   get(target, key) {     if (key === 'then') return undefined;     if (key === Symbol.iterator) return function* () {};     if (key === Symbol.toPrimitive) return () => '';     if (key === 'length') return 0;     if (key === 'toString') return () => '';     if (key === 'toJSON') return () => null;     return anything;   },   apply() { return anything; },   has() { return true; }, }); window.__asked = []; request = async (path) => { window.__asked.push(path); return anything; }; return 'the page now behaves like the app, and nothing it does can escape';

steps.script: const goesAway = (button) => button.textContent.trim() === 'Work on this'; const press = async (button, id) => { if (goesAway(button)) return;   let threw = '';   const before = window.__sweep.errors.length;   try { button.click(); } catch (error) { threw = String((error && error.message) || error); }   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50));   window.__sweep.results.push({id, threw, newErrors: window.__sweep.errors.length - before});   for (const box of [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog')]) {     if (box.open) { box.returnValue = 'cancel'; box.close(); }   } }; const nameOf = (button) => button.id || ('the one saying "' + button.textContent.trim().slice(0, 40) + '"'); const views = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]')].map(one => one.dataset.view); for (const view of views) {   switchView(view);   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));   for (const button of [...document.querySelectorAll('button')]) {     if (!button.isConnected) continue;     await press(button, nameOf(button));   } } openTheProjects(true); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); for (const button of [...document.querySelectorAll('#projectSidebar button')]) {   if (button.isConnected) await press(button, nameOf(button)); } for (const tab of [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pipeline-tab]')]) {   tab.click();   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));   for (const button of [...document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-pane button')]) {     if (button.isConnected) await press(button, nameOf(button));   } } return 'every one of them was pressed';
steps.text: every one of them was pressed
steps.note: Press every button in every view, but not the one that moves to another project - that reloads the page, which would end the sweep rather than tell anybody anything

steps.script: const done = window.__sweep.results; if (done.length < 150) return 'only ' + done.length + ' were pressed, which is too few'; const broke = done.filter(one => one.threw || one.newErrors > 0); return broke.length   ? 'these broke: ' + broke.map(one => one.id + ' (' + (one.threw || 'an error nobody caught') + ')').join('; ')   : 'not one of them threw, and not one left an error nobody caught';
steps.text: not one of them threw, and not one left an error nobody caught
steps.note: A button that throws, or leaves an error nobody catches, is a button that does nothing and says nothing

steps.note: Open the board

steps.script: const waitFor = async (test) => { for (let tries = 0; tries < 160; tries += 1) { if (await test()) return true; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return false; }; const saveBoard = (board) => request('/api/swarm/save', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({board: Object.assign({}, board, {version: undefined})})}); if (!await waitFor(() => !document.getElementById('swarmView').hidden)) return 'the board never opened'; window.__boardWas = (await request('/api/swarm')).board; const who = ((await request('/api/swarm')).who_can_be_used.find(one => one.ready) || {}).route || ''; const here = (await request('/api/projects')).here.path; await saveBoard({agents: [{id: 'agent-1', name: 'Check agent one', who, at: {x: 40, y: 40}}, {id: 'agent-2', name: 'Check agent two', who, at: {x: 300, y: 40}}], projects: [{id: 'project-1', path: here, tasks: ['Make every check pass'], at: {x: 40, y: 420}}], works_on: [{agent: 'agent-1', project: 'project-1'}, {agent: 'agent-2', project: 'project-1'}], talks_to: []}); document.getElementById('swarmRefresh').click(); if (!await waitFor(async () => swarmSaid.board.version === (await request('/api/swarm')).board.version)) return 'the panel never caught up with the board'; if (!await waitFor(() => document.querySelectorAll('.swarm-box').length === 3)) return 'the board was not drawn'; return 'the board is ready to work on';

NO')) return 'a pair who may not talk is not said out loud: ' + said.join(', '); if (!document.querySelectorAll('#swarmLines line.crossed-out').length) return 'the line they may not talk over is not crossed out'; return 'every line says what it is, and a pair who may not talk is crossed out';

steps.script: const waitFor = async (test) => { for (let tries = 0; tries < 160; tries += 1) { if (await test()) return true; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return false; }; const saveBoard = (board) => request('/api/swarm/save', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({board: Object.assign({}, board, {version: undefined})})}); if (!await waitFor(() => !document.getElementById('swarmView').hidden)) return 'the board never opened'; window.__boardWas = (await request('/api/swarm')).board; const who = ''; const here = (await request('/api/projects')).here.path; await saveBoard({agents: [{id: 'agent-1', name: 'Tray agent one', who}, {id: 'agent-2', name: 'Tray agent two', who}], projects: [{id: 'project-1', path: here, tasks: []}], works_on: [{agent: 'agent-1', project: 'project-1'}, {agent: 'agent-2', project: 'project-1'}], talks_to: [{one: 'agent-1', other: 'agent-2'}]}); document.getElementById('swarmRefresh').click(); if (!await waitFor(async () => swarmSaid.board.version === (await request('/api/swarm')).board.version)) return 'the panel never caught up with the board'; for (const agent of swarmSaid.board.agents) { agent.ready = true; agent.why_not = ''; } renderSwarmBoard(); window.__trayRealRequest = window.request; window.__trayLoads = 0; window.request = async (...args) => { const chat = String(args[0]).startsWith('/api/swarm/chats?'); if (chat) window.__trayLoads += 1; try { return await window.__trayRealRequest(...args); } finally { if (chat) window.__trayLoads -= 1; } }; return 'two agents to have chats with';
steps.text: two agents to have chats with
steps.note: Two chats, because one chat needs no tray

steps.script: const waitFor = async (test) => { for (let tries = 0; tries < 160; tries += 1) { if (await test()) return true; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); } return false; }; pickSwarmBox('agent', 'agent-1'); document.getElementById('swarmAgentIcon').value = 'brain'; document.getElementById('swarmAgentIcon').dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); document.getElementById('swarmAgentColour').value = '#ff8844'; document.getElementById('swarmAgentColour').dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); document.getElementById('swarmAgentBubbleColour').value = '#302050'; document.getElementById('swarmAgentBubbleColour').dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); document.getElementById('swarmAgentColour').dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); document.getElementById('swarmAgentBubbleColour').dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); document.getElementById('swarmAgentSave').click(); const rendered = await waitFor(() => { const one = theSwarmAgent('agent-1'); const box = document.querySelector('.swarm-box[data-id="agent-1"]'); return one && one.icon === 'brain' && one.colour === '#ff8844' && one.bubble_colour === '#302050' && box?.style.getPropertyValue('--agent-colour').trim() === '#ff8844' && box?.querySelector('.swarm-box-pick svg'); }); if (!rendered) return 'the appearance settings were not saved and redrawn'; return 'icon, agent color, and bubble color are controlled in settings';

steps.script: const waitFor = async (test) => { for (let tries = 0; tries < 160; tries += 1) { if (await test()) return true; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); } return false; }; openTheBigChat('agent-2'); if (!await waitFor(() => !document.getElementById('theBigChat').hidden)) return 'it would not open'; const held = swarmChats.find(one => one.agent === 'agent-2'); const before = held.said; held.said = [{who: 'you', text: 'compare both approaches', at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', speaker_name: 'You', recipient_name: 'GPT Codex, Claude2', phase: 'user_prompt'}, {who: 'them', text: 'Claude exact reply', at: '2026-01-01T00:00:01Z', speaker_name: 'Claude2', speaker_route: 'claude', recipient_name: 'GPT Codex', phase: 'agent_reply', model: 'claude-sonnet'}, {who: 'them', text: 'Codex first reply', at: '2026-01-01T00:00:02Z', speaker_name: 'GPT Codex', speaker_route: 'codex', recipient_name: 'Team deliberation', phase: 'lead_draft', model: 'gpt-5.5'}, {who: 'them', text: 'Combined final answer', at: '2026-01-01T00:00:03Z', speaker_name: 'GPT Codex', speaker_route: 'codex', recipient_name: 'You', phase: 'final_answer', model: 'gpt-5.5'}]; renderTheBigChat(); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#theBigChatSaid .the-big-chat-turn')].map(one => one.textContent); const allVisible = rows.length === 4 && rows[0].includes('You → GPT Codex, Claude2') && rows[1].includes('Claude2 → GPT Codex') && rows[1].includes('Claude exact reply') && rows[1].includes('Connected-agent reply') && rows[1].includes('route claude') && rows[2].includes(`Lead agent's first reply`) && rows[3].includes('Final answer'); held.said = before; renderTheBigChat(); document.getElementById('theBigChatSmall').click(); return allVisible ? 'the chat shows the exact user, connected-agent, lead-draft, and final-answer turns in order' : 'the multi-agent transcript rendered as ' + JSON.stringify(rows);
